subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should the remaining Google/Gemini auth-profile service-env exposure be fixed by rebasing and narrowing this PR over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96065, or should auth-profile credential rendering be handled separately?
rationale: Current main partially fixes the linked security issue, but auth-profile env refs still have an inline source path and the branch is not clean against the merged render-policy work.

options.title: Rebase And Narrow This PR
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflict, keep the auth-profile EnvironmentFile behavior, drop redundant config SecretRef churn, and rerun staged systemd proof.

options.title: Handle Auth Profiles Separately
options.body: Close or pause this PR only if maintainers want a separate broader policy change for auth-profile service credentials.

options.title: Limit Scope To Merged Fix
options.body: Accept the merged config SecretRef fix as sufficient only if maintainers decide auth-profile env refs are out of scope for the linked security issue.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Narrow This PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main conflict, keep the auth-profile EnvironmentFile behavior, drop redundant config SecretRef churn, and rerun staged systemd proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Darren2030 authored the merged current-main policy change that this branch must now reconcile with.
